realmadhuguru.en:
The biggest alpha in AI products over the next few years is in the application layer.

Models will keep getting cheaper, better and more local.

The differentiation will come from deeply understanding specific user workflows and having the imagination to redesign the experience around them.

The denominator of people who can build AI products is about to get enormous.

So being in the top 0.1% of builders will matter more than ever.
realmadhuguru.zh:
未来几年人工智能产品最大的阿尔法是在应用层。

车型将会变得更便宜、更好、更本土化。

差异化将来自于对特定用户工作流程的深入理解，并具有围绕其重新设计体验的想象力。

能够构建人工智能产品的人数将变得巨大。

因此，成为前 0.1% 的建筑商比以往任何时候都更加重要。

levie.en:
Awesome day in terms of new model releases from both Deepseek and Grok. Both of these new model updates represent huge jumps in capability at insanely low costs. 

This is truly Jevons paradox for AI playing out. By bringing down the cost of AI, demand will continue to accelerate. When I talk to enterprises, they have vastly more use-cases for what they’d like agents to handle than generally what they’re able to budget for today. 

They want agents to scan their codebases for security issues. They want agents to review all their documents. They want agents to process information in a large portion of their workflows. And so on. When we bring down the cost of AI or drive up capability levels, it opens up all new use cases in the enterprises, which drives even greater demand.

This is also great for the applied AI layer. The more choice of models - especially those tuned for different types (or costs) of work - the more value there is in being at the layer that can route and optimize based on the task. Great for the entire stack right now.
levie.zh:
Deepseek 和 Grok 发布的新模型真是棒极了。这两种新型号的更新都代表着以极低的成本实现了功能的巨大飞跃。 

这确实是人工智能的杰文斯悖论。通过降低人工智能的成本，需求将继续加速。当我与企业交谈时，他们希望代理处理的用例比他们今天能够预算的用例要多得多。 

他们希望代理扫描他们的代码库以查找安全问题。他们希望代理人审查他们的所有文件。他们希望代理能够在大部分工作流程中处理信息。等等。当我们降低人工智能的成本或提高能力水平时，它会在企业中开辟所有新的用例，从而推动更大的需求。

这对于应用的人工智能层来说也非常有用。模型的选择越多——尤其是那些针对不同类型（或成本）的工作进行调整的模型——位于可以根据任务进行路由和优化的层中的价值就越大。现在非常适合整个堆栈。
